t: Time 3182Y white flexible cable delivers reliable performance for storage heaters and immersion heater installations. This 10m coil features a robust 2-core design with brown and blue copper conductors rated 300/500V. The substantial 1.5mm² conductor area safely manages the higher current demands of heating appliances, whilst the heat-resistant PVC sheath maintains integrity between -15°C and 70°C. With 48 strands per core, the cable provides exceptional flexibility for complex routing and secure, long-term connections in heating system applications. - Rated for storage heaters and immersion heaters - 1.5mm² copper conductors handle higher current safely - Heat-resistant PVC sheath with 48 strands per core
b: Suitable for Storage Heaters & Immersion Heaters
